versions.changelog: v1.1.0: delegation contract for search, read, research, test, review, and single-writer units

- Added references/capability-orchestration.md, moving discovery schema reference from project root to the references directory.
- Removed capability-orchestration.md and skill-card.md from the root directory.
- Updated SKILL.md: reference path for the discovery schema now points to references/capability-orchestration.md.
- SKILL.md now includes license, compatibility, and version metadata fields.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated capability-orchestration.md (details not shown here).
- No changes to core orchestration logic or user workflow.
- Documentation remains the source of truth for orchestration steps.

- Clarified that the skill no longer attempts to install OMC; install instructions moved to the Reference section.
- Updated install reference language in Pre-Check to refer to the Reference section instead of providing direct install commands.
- No functional changes to orchestration logic or usage recommendations.

Initial release: Skill for Claude Code + OMC dynamic agent orchestration.

- Enables autonomous, per-task delegation using OMC’s full agent and feature set (Team Mode, Autopilot, Ultrawork, Ralph, Pipeline) in Claude Code when OMC is installed.
- Runs multi-level checks for OMC installation, agent and feature availability, with granular fallback logic.
- Actively discovers available OMC capability surfaces and adapts orchestration route on each use.
- Includes strict runtime checks and fallback rules for non-OMC or incompatible environments.
- Reference install instructions, upgrade/removal steps, and transparency requirements provided.
